errors.name: ClientNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice or payment references a client that does not exist in the system.

errors.name: InvoiceNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice is referenced in a payment or lookup but does not exist in the system.

errors.name: PaymentNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a payment is referenced but does not exist in the system.

errors.name: MissingClientReferenceError
errors.description: Raised when an invoice is created without a valid client_id reference.

errors.name: MissingInvoiceReferenceError
errors.description: Raised when a payment is created without a valid invoice_id reference.
